claims.verbatim:
Steamship City of Boston (Br), Brooks, Liverpool Aug 29,
via Queenstown 30th, with mdse and 665[?] passengers, to John
G Dale. Aug 30, 18 miles NE of Tuskar, passed steamship
Erin, hence for Liverpool; same day, 12 miles west of Tus-
kar, steamship Etna; 31st, 45[?] miles west of Fastnet, steam-
ship Java—both hence for Liverpool; Sept 2, lat 40[?] 55[?], lon 27
36[?], ship Transit, bound W; 5th, 257 miles E of Cape Race,
steamship City of Paris, hence for Liverpool; 6th, off Cape
Race, an extra Cunard steamer, bound W; 7th, lat 43, lon 61[?]
07, steamship Persia, hence for Liverpool; 9th, 178 miles
W of Sandy Hook, steamship City of New York, do for do;
a Bremen steamer, bound E; also steamships Pennsylvania,
Britannia, Napoleon III, and William Penn—all bound E.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted Sandy Hook 280 miles E of Sandy Hook (23d 2 p. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Iowa (Br.), Craig, Glasgow 10th, and Moville 11th inst.,
p. m., with mdse. and 250 pass. to F. Macdonald & Co. Aug. 10, 30
miles from Greenock, passed steamship Hibernia, bound in; 15th, lat.
53 50, long. 28 40, steamship United Kingdom, hence for Glasgow;
23d, 2 p. m., 280 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Java, bound E;
same day, 6 p. m., 250 miles E of Sandy Hook, steamship Tripoli,
bound E; off Nantucket, passed ship American Union, from Havre
for New-York.

claims.claim: Spoken / sighted lat. 44 12, long. 56 30 (25th 6 a. m.)
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Pennsylvania (Br.), Lewis, Liverpool, Aug. 15, and
Queenstown 16th, with mdse. and 518 pass. to the National Steam
Nav. Company. 16th inst., off Tuskar, passed ship Screamer bound
up; 17th, lat. 51 24, long. 19 44, steamship Scotia bound E; 19th, lat.
51 09, long. 25, steamship City of Boston bound E; 22d, lat. 48 24, lon.
43, Br. ship Elizabeth Yeo, from Newport, for Montreal; 24th, lat. 45
08, long. 53 13, ship Sebastopol bound E; 25th, 6 a. m., lat. 44 12,
long. 56 30, steamship Java, bound E; same day, 3:14 p. m., lat. 43 47,
long. 57 44, steamship Tripoli, bound E; 27th, lat. 41 29, long. 63 37,
steamship Ericsson bound E.
